title: PatchDefinition
description: A single patch: the file to modify and the operations to apply to it. Can be processed on its own or as part of a PatchSet.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference used by editors for completion and validation; ignored by the patch processor.

file.description: Path to the file to patch. Placeholders of the form ${...} are replaced from environment variables. If the file does not exist, the patch is skipped with a warning.

ops.description: Operations to apply to the file, in order.

file-format.description: Overrides format detection. When omitted, the format is detected from the file's suffix.

JsonPath.description: The JSONPath to the field to modify. For example: "$.store.book[0].title". See https://github.com/json-path/JsonPath#readme for the full syntax.
JsonPath.markdownDescription:
The JSONPath to the field to modify.

For example, `$.store.book[0].title` selects the `title` field of the first element of the `book` array.

See the [JsonPath documentation](https://github.com/json-path/JsonPath#readme) for the full syntax.

Value.description: The value for the operation. String values support placeholders of the form ${...}, which are replaced from environment variables; if a referenced variable is not set, the operation is skipped with a warning. The interpolated string can be converted to another type with value-type. Non-string values are used as-is.

ValueType.description: Converts the string value, after placeholder interpolation, to another type: one of the basic types, or 'list of ...' to parse a list from a comma-separated string. 'auto' converts to int, float, or bool as appropriate; 'bool' accepts true/false/yes/no. Useful with environment variable placeholders, which are always strings. When omitted, the value remains a string.

$set.description: Sets an existing field to a new value. To add a new field, use the $put operation.

$put.description: Adds or updates a field with the given key within an object.

$add.description: Adds a value to an array.

PatchOperation.description: A single operation: an object with one key ($set, $put, or $add) whose value is the operation's arguments. Example: { "$set": { "path": "$.verbose", "value": true } }
PatchOperation.markdownDescription:
A single operation: an object with one key (`$set`, `$put`, or `$add`) whose value is the operation's arguments.

Example:
```json
{ "$set": { "path": "$.verbose", "value": true } }
```
